Reranking where the provider lists the scored documents under data instead of results

```c title="C"
#include <assert.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "liter_llm.h"

int main(void) {
    const char* api_key = getenv("API_KEY");
    LITERLLMAlefHandle rerank_request_handle = literllm_rerank_request_from_json("{\"documents\":[\"The weather is sunny today.\",\"Deep learning uses neural networks.\",\"Machine learning is a subset of AI.\"],\"model\":\"voyage/rerank-2\",\"query\":\"What is machine learning?\"}");
    LITERLLMAlefHandle client = literllm_create_client(api_key, NULL, (uint64_t)-1, (uint32_t)-1, NULL);
    LITERLLMAlefHandle result = literllm_default_client_rerank(client, rerank_request_handle);
    literllm_rerank_response_free(result);
    literllm_rerank_request_free(rerank_request_handle);
    literllm_default_client_free(client);
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}
```
